traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.description: Advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put you to sleep.

traits.name: Trance
traits.description: Don't need to sleep; instead meditate deeply for 4 hours a day, gaining the same benefit a human gets from 8 hours of sleep.

traits.name: Keen Senses
traits.description: Proficiency in the Perception skill.

traits.name: Elf Weapon Training
traits.description: Proficiency with longsword, shortsword, shortbow, and longbow.

traits.name: Cantrip
traits.description: Know one wizard cantrip of your choice; Intelligence is its spellcasting ability.

traits.name: Extra Language
traits.description: Speak, read, and write one extra language of your choice.

traits.name: Elf Weapon Training
traits.description: Proficiency with longsword, shortsword, shortbow, and longbow.

traits.name: Fleet of Foot
traits.description: Base walking speed increases to 35 feet.

traits.name: Mask of the Wild
traits.description: Can attempt to hide even when only lightly obscured by foliage, heavy rain, falling snow, mist, and other natural phenomena.

traits.name: Superior Darkvision
traits.description: Darkvision extends to 120 feet.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.description: Disadvantage on attack rolls and Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight when the target/you are in direct sunlight.

traits.name: Drow Magic
traits.description: Know the Dancing Lights cantrip. At 3rd level, cast Faerie Fire once per long rest; at 5th level, also cast Darkness once per long rest. Charisma is the spellcasting ability.

traits.name: Drow Weapon Training
traits.description: Proficiency with rapiers, shortswords, and hand crossbows.

traits.name: Dwarven Resilience
traits.description: Advantage on saving throws against poison, and resistance to poison damage.

traits.name: Dwarven Combat Training
traits.description: Proficiency with the battleaxe, handaxe, light hammer, and warhammer.

traits.name: Tool Proficiency
traits.description: Proficiency with the artisan's tools of your choice: smith's tools, brewer's supplies, or mason's tools.

traits.name: Stonecunning
traits.description: Whenever you make an Intelligence (History) check related to the origin of stonework, you are considered proficient in the History skill and add double your proficiency bonus to the check, instead of your normal proficiency bonus.

traits.name: Dwarven Toughness
traits.description: Hit point maximum increases by 1, and increases by 1 every time you gain a level.

traits.name: Dwarven Armor Training
traits.description: Proficiency with light and medium armor.

traits.name: Lucky
traits.description: When you roll a 1 on an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw, you can reroll the die and must use the new roll.

traits.name: Brave
traits.description: Advantage on saving throws against being frightened.

traits.name: Halfling Nimbleness
traits.description: Can move through the space of any creature that is of a size larger than yours.

traits.name: Naturally Stealthy
traits.description: Can attempt to hide even when obscured only by a creature at least one size larger than you.

traits.name: Stout Resilience
traits.description: Advantage on saving throws against poison, and resistance to poison damage.

traits.name: Draconic Ancestry
traits.description: Choose a dragon type (black, blue, brass, bronze, copper, gold, green, red, silver, or white) — determines your Breath Weapon's damage type/shape and your Damage Resistance.

traits.name: Breath Weapon
traits.description: Action: exhale destructive energy in a 5-by-30-ft. line or a 15-ft. cone (shape, damage type, and save ability all set by your draconic ancestry). Each creature in the area makes a Dex or Con save (DC 8 + Con mod + proficiency bonus) for half damage; 2d6 at 1st level, 3d6 at 6th, 4d6 at 11th, 5d6 at 16th. Usable again only after a short or long rest.

traits.name: Damage Resistance
traits.description: Resistance to the damage type associated with your draconic ancestry.

traits.name: Gnome Cunning
traits.description: Advantage on all Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws against magic.

traits.name: Natural Illusionist
traits.description: Know the Minor Illusion cantrip; Intelligence is its spellcasting ability.

traits.name: Speak with Small Beasts
traits.description: Communicate simple ideas with Small or smaller beasts, through gestures, sounds, and body language.

traits.name: Artificer's Lore
traits.description: Add twice your proficiency bonus to History checks related to magic items, alchemical objects, or technological devices.

traits.name: Tinker
traits.description: Proficiency with tinker's tools. Can spend 1 hour and 10gp of materials to construct a Tiny clockwork device (AC 5, 1 HP): a clockwork toy, fire starter, or music box.

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.description: Advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put you to sleep.

traits.name: Skill Versatility
traits.description: Proficiency in two skills of your choice.

traits.name: Relentless Endurance
traits.description: When reduced to 0 hit points but not killed outright, you can drop to 1 hit point instead. Usable again only after a long rest.

traits.name: Savage Attacks
traits.description: When you score a critical hit with a melee weapon attack, roll one additional weapon damage die and add it to the extra critical-hit damage.

traits.name: Menacing
traits.description: Proficiency in the Intimidation skill.

traits.name: Hellish Resistance
traits.description: Resistance to fire damage.

traits.name: Infernal Legacy
traits.description: Know the Thaumaturgy cantrip. At 3rd level, cast Hellish Rebuke once as a 2nd-level spell, regaining the ability on a long rest. At 5th level, also cast Darkness once, regaining the ability on a long rest. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these.
